description: SINOE ® - Tonnage déchèteries par type de déchet et département is published by ADEME. The table reports collection-centre tonnages by waste type and department. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. Only material passing through the relevant collection-centre system is included. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
